title: motion_pixel_diff
description: Detects motion in grayscale frames by differencing each frame against a running background model and publishes motion events.

frame_width.description: Width in pixels of the grayscale frames the plugin receives.

frame_height.description: Height in pixels of the grayscale frames the plugin receives.

threshold.description: Per-pixel absolute difference from the background above which a pixel counts as changed.

min_pixels.description: Number of changed pixels at or above which a global motion event is published.

downscale.description: Analysis resolution: 1 keeps the source size, 2 halves it, 0 uses out_width and out_height.

zone_aware.description: Evaluate per-zone motion and publish zone_motion events when zones are available.

enable_background_update.description: Blend each frame into the background model.

background_learning_rate.description: Weight of the new frame when updating the background model.

enable_motion_map.description: Build a motion visualization map for each frame.

enable_filtering.description: Apply spatial filtering to the motion mask.

plate_export.description: Write the background model to disk as a JPEG plate and publish a background_plate event.

plate_dir.description: Directory plate JPEGs are written to; plate export is off while this is empty.

plate_on_illum_change.description: Also write a plate when the mean brightness shifts noticeably.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id included in published motion events.
